senses.gloss: m. = next w.—Pl. <cite ref="U00064"><he>שַׁבָּאֵי</he></cite>, <cite ref="U00075"><he>שַׁבּוֹיֵי</he></cite>. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joḥ. 1) Moses said to them <he>ש׳ אי בחייכון אתון קטולי וכ׳</he> you captors, oh, by your own lives, (I adjure you,) do not commit merciless slaughter.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 23a:15">Keth. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>אוקמן לשַׁבּוֹיִינְהִי וכ׳</he> (Rashi <he>לשבוייהי</he>) they let their captors stand outside of the college &c.
